title: Test a New Customer Segment Before You Hire
summary: Find out if a new type of customer wants what you sell by building a small researched lead list with outreach drafts, before you hire a sales rep or change your offer.

money_potential.label: Medium
money_potential.basis: Assumes you sell to businesses and want to test a new type of customer; the value is research time saved and a clear answer before hiring.
money_potential.note: Value tiers are our rough estimates (labelled Estimate) of relative value to the business, each with its assumption. They are not promises, income claims or advice. Results depend on your market, offer and effort.

how_it_makes_money: You learn if a new market replies before you pay for a salesperson.
Every first message starts from real research, not a template.
who_its_for: Founders who do their own sales.
Agencies and consultants opening a new niche.

stack.name: Outbound Desk
stack.role: Reads your website, finds likely customers in the new segment and drafts email, X and LinkedIn messages in one shared sheet.
stack.creator: monokern

stack.name: Lookalike Scout
stack.role: Turns one good customer into a list of similar companies and decision-makers to add to the test.
stack.creator: Treg team

inputs.label: Your website and one good customer

steps.name: You
steps.does: Edit, send a small batch and count replies

outputs: A researched lead list with drafts
A clear yes or no on the segment

steps: Describe the new segment and the one reason they should care.
Build a small list from your website and one good customer.
Edit every draft and send a small batch yourself.
Count replies and decide whether the segment is worth more effort.
guardrails: You send every message yourself; nothing goes out on its own.
Follow anti-spam rules for each channel and country, and offer an easy opt-out on email.
